title: a project whose jitso script is blank gets the plain launcher word in the guard's deny reason
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-26). The guard and the card share one rule for the jitso script: a blank value is not declared. The reason of a denied worker start names `jitso launch --build <id>`, never `bun run jitso`.

tool_input.command: orca orchestration worker-start --run r1 --task t1 --terminal term_1
